t: This is St Paul's Church in Knightsbridge, at 32a Wilton Place. It's an Anglican church in the Anglo-Catholic tradition, and it's Grade II* listed. It was designed by Thomas Cundy the younger, an English architect who succeeded his father as surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate. He held that position during the main phase of the development of Belgravia and Pimlico by the contractor Thomas Cubitt, which is the district's story in a nutshell.
